title: aye ali akbar mere
body:
aye ali akbar mere aye ali akbar
kho gaye ho tum kahaa'n dhundti maadar
dil me ye armaan tha dekhu mai sehra tera
haaye qismat kya kahu qoon me laasha mila
<<DIVIDER>>
sej phulou ki jagah qaak ka bistar
ab nahi koi jawaa'n jal chuke qaime yahaa'n
asghare nadaan bhi chal diye sooe jinaa'n
be kafan abbas hai qaak par besar
<<DIVIDER>>
maatame shabbir hai pusht par zanjeer hai
sar khule bazaar me zainabe dilgeer hai
has rahe hai shaan se ham pe ehle shar
bewa hai kubra dulhan dulha rab me bekafan
<<DIVIDER>>
ab to aaja laadle lut gaya sheh ka chaman
hum aseere karbala phir chuke dar dar
ek sakina si behan channi kodou se badan
baandhne ko laaya hai shumr hathou me rasan
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm ki hai inteha chin gaye gouhar
